items.source: Null-safe invocation is supported via the '?.' operator. For example, 'counter?.incrementBy(1)' will evaluate to null if counter is null and will otherwise evaluate to the value returned from the invocation of counter.incrementBy(1). As of Spring Framework 7.0, null-safe invocation also applies when invoking a method on an Optional target. For example, if counter is of type Optional<Counter>, the expression 'counter?.incrementBy(1)' will evaluate to null if counter is null or empty and will otherwise evaluate the value returned from the invocation of counter.get().incrementBy(1).
items.translation: 空安全调用通过 `'?.'` 运算符支持。例如，如果 `counter` 为 `null`，则表达式 `'counter?.incrementBy(1)'` 将求值为 `null`；否则，它将求值为对 `counter.incrementBy(1)` 调用返回的值。自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，空安全调用也适用于在 `Optional` 目标上调用方法。例如，如果 `counter` 的类型为 `Optional<Counter>`，则表达式 `'counter?.incrementBy(1)'` 将在 `counter` 为 `null` 或 `empty` 时求值为 `null`，否则将求值对 `counter.get().incrementBy(1)` 调用返回的值。
